title: Aether: four-layer inference observability metric catalog

collection_modes.A: Engine endpoint: event/step-updated; host polls at a supported, unset interval. Endpoint must already be exposed and accessible; enabling optional metrics may require workload configuration.
collection_modes.H: Host source: read counters/state at a supported, unset interval, or capture native events. Driver/kernel permissions and capability checks required.
collection_modes.I: Profiling: supported process/library/device instrumentation; event-driven then buffered. May require injection, plugin loading, configuration or restart; not guaranteed host-only.
collection_modes.X: Conditional: semantic events or integration are required; no universal native export verified. No collection interval or support assumed.
collection_modes.F: External fabric integration: switch telemetry/exporter required; vendor-supported cadence unset.
collection_modes.D: Derived: compute when validated inputs arrive over an explicit event/aggregation window. Inherits all input limitations.
